تخترعوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِعُوا (taḵtariʕū) /tax.ta.ri.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# تُخْتَرَعُوا (tuḵtaraʕū) /tux.ta.ra.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
